_readme: AUTOLISTER starter pack (lister/PLAN.md section 8, WP-L). The dashboard's Library tab imports it
once ("Load the starter pack"); the owner then replaces or extends every line there — this file
is a seed, not the truth. One entry = one headline or one description, with its language.
{warranty} {shop} {hours} {category}. A title segment or a description sentence whose
placeholder is empty is dropped whole (lister-core fillTemplate).
Copy rules (SubSell, every text): cash only — never store credit; payment "sur place" /
"on the spot" — never "same day"; warranty 1 year + lifetime network; no repair / technician /
diagnostic words; hours 9h–21h; no returns wording ("échange gratuit" only).
tagSets must equal lister-core CATEGORIES[*].tags (store/smoke-lister-core.js checks it).
